proposals.title: STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING A REPORT ON CLIMATE RISKS TO RETIREMENT PLAN BENEFICIARIES
proposals.proponent: As You Sow, on behalf of Remmer Family Foundation Inc, Edwards Mother Earth Foundation, Frances L. Bell T/W fbo Roger de Freitas, Humankind Benefit Corporation and The Pleiades Trust
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report disclosing if and how Oracle protects retirement plan beneficiaries, especially those with long horizons, from future portfolio risk from high-carbon plan investments.
proposals.evidence: The Board unanimously recommends a vote AGAINST adoption of Proposal No. 4.
